content.title: SGRY Q2 Deep Dive: Orthopedics and De Novo Expansion Drive Steady Growth
content.summary: Healthcare company Surgery Partners (NASDAQ:SGRY) beat Wall Street’s revenue expectations in Q2 CY2025, with sales up 8.4% year on year to $826.2 million. The company expects the full year’s revenue to be around $3.38 billion, close to analysts’ estimates. Its non-GAAP profit of $0.17 per share was 25.8% above analysts’ consensus estimates.
